notes: «وغير، واحد» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 1, unnamed kind); the four co-transmitters meet at أبو عاصم («قالوا»).
The father of Sulayman is unnamed in the text (relation): the Companion is named only in the compiler's comment («حديث بريدة»), which is not a link.
«قال أبو عيسى» and the list of Companions in «وفي الباب» are the compiler's comments: left out.
